meta.description: Sequence-based deep learning for ATAC-seq using chromBPNet, BPNet, scBasset, or Enformer: Tn5 bias correction, per-base accessibility profiles, in silico variant effects, and DeepLIFT/TF-MoDISco motif discovery.

scientific_integrity.detail: Uncited rules of thumb are labelled; measured numbers in the text match the re-run evidence; limits are stated.

practice_boundaries.detail: Research analysis scope; no clinical claims.

methodological_ground.detail: The log2FC on the log-count head was reproduced by three independent methods (Keras, PyTorch, variant-scorer) and a planted-truth fixture.

code_usability.detail: The shipped pipeline ran end to end from a fresh directory, RESUME works, and the four new scripts ran on real public inputs.

functional_suitability.note: Every documented route now runs; both P0 defects are repaired and reproduced independently.

reliability.note: Fail-fast guards, RESUME and an honest QC gate; bedtools and bedGraphToBigWig are not checked up front (DLA-015).

performance_context.note: SKILL.md stays compact with three focused references; runtimes are recorded with their fixture.

agent_usability.note: Clear routing and copyable commands; three environments must be juggled and one stale step pointer remains (DLA-016).

human_usability.note: Good triggers and boundaries; long reference tables.

security.note: No secrets or destructive actions; paths are quoted and the scorer path is validated.

maintainability.note: Pinned versions and shipped scripts; no shipped regression fixture for the log2FC rule.

agent_specific.note: Progressive disclosure, explicit gates and labelled limitations; restricted items stay unclaimed.

inputs.label: Shipped chromBPNet pipeline, fresh OUTDIR, then RESUME tail and guards
inputs.note: Fresh end-to-end run (prep splits, prep nonpeaks, bias train, train, pred_bw, footprints, QC gate, variant scoring) exited 0 in about 43 min on the real-derived GM12878 fixture at 1 epoch (2700 s cap not reached); the 1-epoch model correctly fails the QC gate

assertions.text: Seven fail-fast guards (missing BAM, 3-col peaks, 4-col variants, placeholder scorer, stale nonpeaks, no chrombpnet, trained OUTDIR) exit 1 in seconds before training
assertions.note: ra_guards_gate.sh: 7 of 7 exit 1 with the documented message

assertions.text: Fresh run creates nonpeaks_negatives.bed, bias.h5, chrombpnet.h5, chrombpnet_nobias.h5, pred_bw metrics and footprints and exits 0
assertions.note: pipe_run1.log exit=0; all artifacts present

assertions.text: QC gate reports the unconverged 1-epoch model as FAIL instead of passing it
assertions.note: bias 0.494 PASS, corrected pearsonr -0.496 FAIL, Tn5 response corrected_0.001 PASS; ALLOW_FAILED_QC continued as documented

assertions.text: Variant table has 18 columns, finite logfc equal to log2(allele2/allele1), null p-values present
assertions.note: 30 rows, max deviation 7e-8, abs_logfc.pval 0.05-0.99

assertions.text: RESUME=1 on the finished OUTDIR skips every training step and re-runs gate plus variant scoring
assertions.note: 22 s wall, exit 0, variant table regenerated

inputs.label: Variant-effect log2FC correctness (P0) with three independent methods
inputs.note: Raw Keras recomputation, shipped score_variants_torch.py and variant-scorer forward-only agree on 200 real NA12878 SNPs; the planted-truth fixture confirms the old formula is 5.5x too small

assertions.text: Formula (alt - ref)/ln2 on the log-count head equals log2(exp(alt)/exp(ref)) computed independently in raw Keras
assertions.note: max diff 2.7e-7 on 200 SNPs

assertions.text: score_variants_torch.py agrees with the independent Keras values
assertions.note: corr 0.9999997, max abs diff 1.1e-3

assertions.text: Keras values agree with variant-scorer --forward_only logfc and its allele counts
assertions.note: corr 1.0, max diff 2.6e-7

assertions.text: Planted-motif fixture: fixed formula near planted truth -2.44, old formula about 5x too small
assertions.note: fixed -2.20 (within 20 percent), old -0.446, ratio 5.47

assertions.text: Documented calling numbers reproduce (2 of 200 exceed abs logfc 1 in default mode; Pearson 0.96 forward-only versus default)
assertions.note: 2/200 and r 0.960 from the scorer default output; 3/200 forward-only

inputs.note: scBasset preprocess, 1-epoch train and embedding run on real 10x PBMC; Enformer matches an independent bin computation; the Skill labels full-scale training, scBasset on Keras 3 and Borzoi as not run; bedtools and bedGraphToBigWig prerequisites are not declared

assertions.note: 184 steps in 760 s, best_model.h5, embedding (32,4609) finite

Skill never claims full-scale chromBPNet training, Borzoi or scBasset on Keras 3 as executed
assertions.note: each is labelled untested or failing in SKILL.md and method-reference

assertions.note: 3-epoch val AUC 0.53 stated; 1-epoch val AUC 0.49 observed

assertions.note: absent from the env table and step 0 (DLA-015); confirmed in chrombpnet source, not by a failing run

key_strengths: The variant-effect formula is now correct and backed by a planted-truth regression plus three independent numerical agreements.
The shipped pipeline runs from a fresh directory, resumes cheaply, fails fast on bad inputs and gates on chromBPNet's own QC thresholds.
Every route (variant-scorer, PyTorch, MoDISco, Enformer, scBasset) has an executed command, and untested items are labelled as such.
Data formats and CLI errors that broke the original Skill are documented with exact messages.

recommendations.title: DLA-015 bedtools and bedGraphToBigWig undeclared
recommendations.problem: chromBPNet 1.0.1 shells out to bedtools (prep nonpeaks) and bedGraphToBigWig (reads_to_bigwig in bias train and train), but the SKILL env table and the script's step 0 check only chrombpnet.
recommendations.root_cause: The env table listed Python packages only; the external binaries were present in the audit environment.
recommendations.fix: Add bedtools and UCSC bedGraphToBigWig (conda: bedtools, ucsc-bedgraphtobigwig) to the chrombpnet row of the env table and to the step 0 command -v checks.

recommendations.title: DLA-016 pipeline header points to the wrong SKILL step
recommendations.problem: scripts/chrombpnet_pipeline.sh line 3 says to run interpretation separately per SKILL.md step 5, but step 5 is variant effects; motif interpretation is step 6.
recommendations.root_cause: Step numbers shifted when the workflow was rewritten.
recommendations.fix: Change the header comment to SKILL.md step 6.
